At ACC we are proud to provide South Australia's first and only  Bachelor of Chiropractic degree accredited by the Tertiary Education and Quality Standards Agency of Australia (TEQSA).

We offer a boutique educational experience, rich in both scientific theory and practical application, with access to some of the best educators and practitioners in the profession. Our curriculum is also unique in offering entrepreneurial business education so that you will be ready to launch your own business and establish yourself as a qualified chiropractor.

Our links with international organisations such the Rubicon Group and the New Zealand College of Chiropractic provide exciting educational exchange and research opportunities for our students and ensure that ACC is at the forefront of chiropractic education and practice.

Graduate practice-ready, and build lasting professional relationships with committed and visionary chiropractors.
